_comment: docs/modules/ado.md, "The switch, and its scope": is Azure DevOps part of what this machine SHOWS? ONE table, two readers -- Tests/Test-Setup.ps1 runs Scripts/Test-AdoEnabled.ps1 over it, Tests/test_ado_enabled.py runs agent/core/config.py's ado_enabled. flag is features.ado as configured: true, false, or null when nobody has said; tracker is what the Space's address names (Resolve-Tracker.ps1, tracker()): ado, github or none. If the two halves ever disagree about a row, one of them is wrong.

rows.why: an active Azure DevOps org, nobody has said: ON -- a real user sees no difference
a local org, nobody has said: OFF -- the machine Start leaves
a connected GitHub Space is active, and its tracker is GitHub: OFF -- the GitHub row says it is connected
the GitHub demo as shipped, local with an address: OFF
active with no address: there is no Azure DevOps to show, OFF
features.ado=false wins over an active org
features.ado=true wins over a local org -- the way back to the old menu
features.ado=true wins over a GitHub tracker too: the explicit answer is the person's
the explicit answer wins over an archived org too
